The accessibility permission is required for the double tap to lock gesture. Any data acquired by Basket Launcher via this service never leaves your device.
Please set Basket Launcher as default first
Note: Tap on \'Basket Launcher\' at the top of this Settings page to find your hidden apps.

Basket Launcher uses the Accessibility Service API for one feature only: Double tap to lock. It lets Basket Launcher lock your screen when you double tap on the home screen. 

The service only sees taps inside Basket Launcher, and only uses them to lock your screen. It does not look at other apps or anything you type. 

No data is collected, stored or shared. Nothing leaves your device. 

Tap Accept, then turn on Basket Launcher in your device's Accessibility settings.
